newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M says 1996 sales rose 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: H&M says 1996 sales rose 28 pct.

text.p: Swedish retailer Hennes & Mauritz said on Thursday that 1996 sales rose 28 percent.
H&M said 59 new stores were opened in 1996 and new investments totalled 700 million crowns.
H&M said that general retail sales trade in Europe was, as in recent years, weak, although some improvement was noted in the second half of 1996.
Sales outside Sweden accounted for 76 percent of total group turnover, compared to 73 percent in 1995. H&M has 443 shops, 117 of which are in Sweden.
"The group will continue to expand strongly in 1997. For the coming year a net addition of around 50 shops is planned, of which five will be in the new market of Finland," H&M added,
H&M repeated that it will begin operations in France in 1998. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
